answers.sql: SELECT (p2 - p1) * 100.0 / p1 AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT transfer_volume FROM exports WHERE period = 'P2') AS p2, (SELECT transfer_volume FROM exports WHERE period = 'P1') AS p1) WHERE p1 > 0;

SELECT (p2 - p1) * 100.0 / p1 AS value FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'P2' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END) AS p2, SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'P1' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END) AS p1 FROM events WHERE event_kind NOT IN ('mint', 'burn')) WHERE p1 > 0;
